brand.name: Ugh!PDF
brand.vibe: Playful but reliable, frictionless, soft utility. A sigh of relief. No harsh brutalism.
brand.archetype: ARCHETYPE 3: PASTEL & SOFT combined with high-contrast borders (Neo-Utility).

headings.description: Clean, rounded geometry, modern and friendly.

rules: Never use Inter or generic sans for headings.
No pure #000000 or #808080. Greys must have a slight tint.
AI tools should use a distinct subtle gradient or the ai_accent color to stand out.

general: Universal drop-zone on home: Use a large hero section with dashed border, active hover states, and drag-and-drop mechanics.
Tool Pages: consistent layout (drop -> configure -> preview -> download) with a sidebar for settings and main area for preview.
Dashboard: Sidebar navigation + top bar + main content area.
grid: Category Filter: Top horizontal scrollable or bento-style row for the 6 categories (Convert, Organize, Optimize, Edit, Security, AI).
Tools Grid: High density responsive grid for the 52 tools. grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4.
Grid items must be direct children of the grid container.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or smooth rounded (rounded-xl) with hover translations and subtle shadows.
components.cards: Subtle roundness (max 12px border-radius). Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and soft shadow.
components.drop_zone: Glassmorphism panel with 'The Tracing Beam' or dashed border indicating it is interactive. Needs to feel large and forgiving.
components.badges: Local vs Server processing badges must be clearly visible on tool cards. 🔒 Local, ☁️ Server.
components.progress: Use Shadcn Progress component with streaming text feedback for long jobs.
shadcn_overrides: Override default card styles to remove heavy shadows and use the 1px subtle border.
Use Shadcn standard components for dropdowns, tabs, etc.

rules: Hover states must include a slight translate and shadow increase.
Use framer-motion for drag-and-drop feedback and entrance animations for the 52 tools.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA standards.

icons.usage: Use duotone or regular weight for a premium, friendly feel.

images.description: Subtle purple and pink mesh gradient to use at low opacity (10-20%) behind the universal drop zone to give it a magical AI feel without being overwhelming.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl and backdrop-saturate-150 for the sticky header and the main universal drop zone.
visual_enhancers.noise: Add a very subtle SVG noise overlay to backgrounds to break the digital flatness.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a clean, uncluttered interface. The user is frustrated ('Ugh!PDF'), so the app should feel like a sigh of relief.
Implement the 52-tool grid with efficient space usage. Don't make the cards too large; they need to be scannable.
Ensure the universal drop zone is the most prominent element on the landing page.
For the tool detail page, use a split-pane layout or a clear step-by-step vertical flow (Drop -> Configure -> Preview -> Download).
Show AI cost indicators clearly next to the action button (e.g., '✨ Summarize (2 credits)').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
